title: A rules type's groups (docs/rulesets.md#rules-groups)
description: rulesets/<ruleset>/rules/<type>-groups.json: the type's groups, in page order. A primitive or extension names its leaf group in stats.group and belongs to that group and every ancestor. Groups are closed: extensions add members, not groups.

id.description: The group's id; its key is <type>/<id>, a link target like a primitive's.

name.description: The group's name, its section heading.

qualifier.description: The group's short form, such as "Martial" for Martial Weapons.

noun.description: A category's singular noun, such as "Weapon", added after a lone group's qualifier where the ruleset words one (docs/rulesets.md#items).

parent.description: The id of the group this one nests in. A group with no parent is a category.

union.description: The ids of the groups this one joins. A union group has no members of its own, and its section lists its members after the tree.

note.description: Printed in parentheses after the heading.

text.description: SRD prose that opens the group's section, in the markdown subset.

sortBy.description: How the group's members print: by these paths into each member's stats and derived values, in turn (such as ["stats.armor.ac", "derived.costGp"]), then by name. Omitted, by name.
